pairs.subject: convergence-loop-and-requeue
pairs.evidence: src/features/triggers/sub_shared/useSubscribedFeeds.ts:9 This context is React UI that reads the feed catalog, subscriptions and activity once per mount or button press (useSharedEvents.load, useSubscribedFeeds), plus a manual test-fire form. Nothing here drives observed state toward a declared record, keeps a keyed queue, requeues or drains, so the subject's precondition does not hold. Searching src/features/triggers for requeue/converge/workqueue/work_queue/backoff found nothing. The only 'reconcile' hit (FeedRoutingPopover.tsx:89) filters a selection against the roster on save; it is not a loop.

techniques.evidence: src/features/triggers/sub_shared/useSharedEvents.ts:29 A one-shot fetch on mount or refresh. No trigger stream is collapsed to a key for any convergence pass.
src/features/triggers/sub_test/TestTab.tsx:152 Looks a bit like the technique: a UI effect skips its own write. But it resets a form prefill, not a convergence loop, so it is not evidence either way.
src/features/triggers/sub_shared/useSharedEvents.ts:29 No queue. A load sequence counter only discards stale responses.
